summary.headline: Antiscion and Planetary Aspects
summary.text: The two inferior planets can form only conjunction and sextile because of their relation to the Sun. The text defines daily or temporal antiscion (agreement of path) across Cancer and introduces ascensional antiscion (agreement of power) across Aries, with Taurus–Leo as an example.
